user.title: Connect to the Orion MQTT broker
user.description: Enter the address of your anonymous local MQTT broker. Beds are discovered automatically when they send telemetry. This uses its own connection, separate from Home Assistant's MQTT integration.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect and subscribe. Check the broker address, port, and anonymous MQTT access.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname, without a URL scheme or port.
